approach: Its own Macromedia Director 4/5 runtime in C (RIFX container, cast, score, Lingo bytecode VM) that plays the original movies, plus native replacements for the game's DLLs
notes: Plays the Dutch CD and its 2003 re-pressing, the Nordic CD in Danish, Norwegian, Swedish and Finnish, and the first Danish CD (Director 4) from your own CD. The game has no code in an exe: all logic is Lingo in the .dxr movies, disassembled and decompiled with the project's own tools. Not supported: the later Director 8.5 and 10 re-releases. The Switch build is experimental (homebrew).
